name: iam:CreatePolicyVersion + sts:AssumeRole
description: Create a new version of a customer-managed policy with admin permissions, then assume a role that has this policy attached. The new policy version takes effect immediately for all principals with that policy.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Customer-managed policy must be attached to a role the attacker can assume
Target role must trust the attacking principal

additional.description: Discover roles with the target policy attached

admin: A customer-managed policy must be attached to a target role
Target role's trust policy must allow your principal to assume it
lateral: A customer-managed policy must be attached to a target role
Target role's trust policy must allow your principal to assume it

references.title: AWS Privilege Escalation Methods and Mitigation

options.name: POLICY_ARN
options.description: ARN of the customer-managed policy to create a new version of

options.name: TARGET_ROLE
options.description: ARN of the IAM role to assume (must have the policy attached)

options.name: AUTO_SWITCH
options.description: Automatically switch to new identity after assuming the role
